algorithm.direction: The first row member chooses the current component. Every later distinct component is appended into that current component, then its original name is deleted.
algorithm.namesAndCounter: Unassigned IDs create empty networks at the exact original getOrCreate site, including empty networks that immediately merge. Names, creation counter and active deletion/insertion order are unchanged.
algorithm.order: Active components have disjoint member sets. Ordered linked-list concatenation is exactly the original Set.add encounter order; every ID allocates one member and final arrays are fresh.
algorithm.constructor: The original new ConnectivityMap call remains at the same site. Object.fromEntries, final plain-object enumeration, special-ID behavior, idToNetMap descriptors/prototype and netMap argument alias stay Native.
algorithm.unchangedOwnerTransitions: All contact predicate sites, original exceptions, interner/FIFO IDs/values/counters, miss plans, scaled polygon construction, graph trace aliases, error assembly and prepared fact publication remain original.

cpuAttribution.limitation: This attributes original frozen whole-stage JSC samples, not a microbenchmark. Nested group shares overlap; nearest frame and leaf rows are separate exclusive partitions. Host waits and transport serialization are included. Newer depth-validation and intern-scope reductions were not present in this frozen profile, so their old frames do not justify further production changes. Worker CPU is absent; all-sample Blacksmith wall time remains acceptance evidence.
